claims.text: The 2024 request to rezone this parcel to M-2 was recommended for denial: at its April 17, 2024 meeting the South Fulton Planning Commission, on case Z24-002 (which lists 7500 Herndon Road), voted to deny the case (the motion is at the top of minutes page 3; the case heading is at the foot of page 2). The Mayor and Council decision was not found, so whether this parcel is M-2 today rests on the screener's map layer only.
claims.quote: Commissioner Boone made a motion to deny the case. Commissioner Hadley seconded the motion. Yay: 3 (Hadley, DeVaughn, Boone)

claims.text: The case heading in the same minutes: Z24-002, a request to rezone from R-2 and AG-1 to M-2, covering 7460, 7490 and 7500 Herndon Road and 7565 and 7635 Bishop Road (78.3 acres).
claims.quote: Case Z24-002: Application by Alain Iskandar requesting a rezone from the R-2 (SingleFamily Dwelling District) AG-1 (Agricultural District) to M-2 (Heavy Industrial District)

claims.text: The Z24-002 staff memo lists this parcel id (07 260001221014) first among the five parcels in the request.
Purpose of the 2024 request: M-2 for industrial outdoor storage or industrial service facilities across the 78.3 acres; staff recommended denial.
claims.quote: The applicant is requesting to rezone from the AG-1 (Agricultural) zoning district and R-2 (Single Family Dwelling District) to M-2 (Heavy Industrial) zoning district to develop the properties for Industrial Outdoor Storage (IOS) or Industrial Service Facilities (ISF) on 78.3 acres of land.

claims.text: Before the case the five parcels were a mix of R-2, AG-1 and M-2; which part of 7500 Herndon Road (if any) was already M-2 is not said in the text (the case maps are images).
claims.quote: Existing Zoning: R-2 (Single-Family Dwelling District), AG-1 (Agricultural District) , & M-2 (Heavy Industrial)

claims.text: Outdoor storage needed a separate special use permit, and the companion case U24-001 named 7500 Herndon Road; staff recommended denial and its outcome was not found.
claims.quote: The applicant is requesting a special use permit for outdoor storage on 7565 Bishop, 7635 Bishop, 7460 Herndon, 7490 Herndon, and 7500 Herndon Road.

claims.text: If the parcel is M-2, the district's purpose statement (quoted in the staff memo) names distributing, terminal and warehousing uses. This is the intent statement, not the use table (Municode is a known wall).
claims.quote: The M-2 District is intended to provide locations for a full range of manufacturing, fabricating, processing, distributing, research, office associated with industrial use, extraction, and terminal and warehousing uses.

open_items: Ask South Fulton planning for the Mayor and Council action on Z24-002 and U24-001 after the April 17, 2024 Planning Commission denial recommendation (approved, denied, withdrawn), with the ordinance number and any conditions of zoning on 7500 Herndon Road. If council denied it, the parcel may still be AG-1/R-2 (rezoning_needed), not M-2 as the screener's layer reads.

Confirm the parcel's current zoning on the official city map (the city zoning layer is on ArcGIS Online, a known wall). Fulton County's own zoning layer (PropertyMapViewer layer 34), asked at the parcel point, returned no feature; that layer appears to cover only unincorporated or county-administered areas, so it says nothing here.
The M-2 use table (warehouse, distribution, outdoor storage) is on Municode (known wall) and could not be quoted.

The Z24-002 memo header still says PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDATION: 30-DAY DEFERRAL, apparently carried from the March 20, 2024 deferral; the April 17, 2024 minutes record the denial vote. A person should read both.

claims.text: Case CDP-004 (2024) proposed to move 7500 Herndon Road and the four other case parcels from Rural Neighborhood to the Industrial character area of the 2021 comprehensive plan; staff recommended approval.
claims.quote: redesignate the properties located at 7565 and 7635 Bishop Road; 7460, 7490 and 7500 Herndon Road from Rural Neighborhood Character Area to the Industrial Character Area.

claims.text: CDP-004 staff recommendation.
claims.quote: STAFF RECOMMENDATION: APPROVAL

claims.text: CDP-004 was brought as a council member's resolution (not by the 2024 applicant), after the Planning Commission had recommended denial of the Z24-002 rezoning in April 2024.
claims.quote: Case CDP-004: A resolution by Councilman Sebastian to amend the City of South Fulton

claims.text: The Planning Commission voted 3 to 1 on September 18, 2024 to approve CDP-004 (vote at the top of minutes page 7). The council resolution itself was not found; the brief's future land use, Industrial Zone, matches the proposed designation.
claims.quote: Commissioner Hadley made a motion to approve the case. Commissioner Jones seconded the motion. Yay: 3 (Hadley, Jones, DeVaughn) Nay: 1 (Boone) Abstain: Motion passed.

claims.text: The city's filed zoning cases list shows CDP-004 with this address and a Planning Commission date only; no Mayor and Council date is shown. No other row on the list names Herndon Road.
claims.quote: CDP-004 7565 & 7635 Bishop Rd; 7460,7490 and 7500 Herndon Road Staff Report 9/18/2024

claims.text: Before CDP-004 the plan pointed the other way: in 2024 staff said the Rural Neighborhood designation did not support M-2 on the case parcels.
claims.quote: The subject property has a future land use designation of Rural Neighborhood as designated in the 2021 South Fulton Comprehensive Plan, which does not support the proposed zoning.

claims.text: Neighbours to the west of the case land are residential and agricultural districts.
claims.quote: West: R-2 (Single Family Dwelling District), AG-1 (Agricultural), & The City of Fairburn

open_items: Ask whether Mayor and Council adopted CDP-004 and when, and which character area the 2026 South Fulton Comprehensive Plan gives 7500 Herndon Road (the 2026 map was not read; lead #115's skeptic found a 2026 Bishop Road memo testing cases against the 2026 plan).

Small homes sit along Herndon Road next to this parcel: the county parcel layer, asked for the parcel's bounding box, shows several 1 to 2.5 acre residential parcels with one living unit at 7440 to 7490 Herndon Road, one with a homestead exemption (an owner-occupied home). Expect buffer and compatibility conditions. This is my reading of the county answer, not a kept claim.
Search snippets only (not verified): Creekside High School is at 7405 Herndon Road. Its distance from this parcel was not measured; a school close by would matter for truck routes and buffers.

claims.text: Sewer, not shown nearby: Fulton County's Waste Water Pipe layer (WR_Public_Map_Viewer layer 4), asked for pipes within 2,000 ft of this parcel's map point (-84.630155, 33.548739), returns an empty feature list.

claims.text: Sewer service area: Fulton County's water/sewer service area layer (layer 16), asked at the same point, answers Fulton County, sewer, service available. That is a service-area polygon, not a nearby main.
claims.quote: "Name":"Fulton County","ServiceTyp":"Sewer","ServiceAva":"Yes"

open_items: Ask who provides water on Herndon Road (City of Fairburn, City of Atlanta or Fulton County), the nearest main and fire flow; the assessor shows well and septic. The county's Service Areas layer (layer 15) returned no feature at the point.

Ask Fulton County Public Works for the nearest public gravity sewer or force main and capacity. Within one mile of the point the county's Force Main layer (layer 6) shows only a short 4-inch main flagged private; it is not a public line to tie into.

claims.text: The 2024 applicant to rezone this parcel for industrial outdoor storage is on the deal team of 9606 Capital, an industrial outdoor storage investor, which bought the neighbouring 7635 Bishop Road (part of the same 2024 case) in early 2024. So an IOS developer's team has pursued this parcel; whether it controls it now is not shown.
claims.quote: 9606 Capital has purchased 7635 Bishop Road in Fairburn, Georgia, a suburb of Atlanta. The IOS property offers easy access to Roosevelt Hwy, I-85, and the CSX Intermodal. The 9606 deal team included Ned Mahic and Alain Iskandar

claims.text: The applicant named on the 2024 use permit for outdoor storage on 7500 Herndon Road and the four other parcels.
claims.quote: Applicant Information: Alain Iskandar Status of Applicant: Applicant

claims.text: The 2024 plan for the 78.3-acre assemblage including this parcel was five warehouses.
claims.quote: The property will consist of 5 warehouses on 78.3 acres of land.

claims.text: The neighbouring outdoor-storage project does not itself cover this parcel: the county parcel layer, asked by parcel id 07 260001350169, shows 7635 Bishop Road as a separate 10.08-acre parcel held by a different company named after its address, with no improvements. From the two parcels' coordinates it lies roughly 1,200 ft east of 7500 Herndon Road (my measure).

claims.text: Landfill watch-out: both 2024 memos describe the five case parcels together as currently a landfill without saying which parcel. Press and the city's own release (not verifiable, see open items) place the illegal dump at 7635 Bishop Road; the county record for 7500 Herndon Road shows a house (see owner).
claims.quote: Current/Past Use of the Property: The property is currently a landfill.

open_items: The last priced deed to the current owner (2024-12-19, per the brief) came after the 2024 cases and after the IOS developer's purchase next door. Ask whether the buyer partnership is linked to 9606 Capital or the 2024 applicant; if so, the parcel is already in a developer's hands for its own project.

Seen, not verifiable: the city's October 29, 2025 release on Bishop Industrial Park (CivicAlerts AID 864) is disallowed by robots.txt at /CivicAlerts.aspx (address cityofsouthfultonga.gov/CivicAlerts.aspx?AID=864); not fetched. Search snippets say 9606 Capital is redeveloping the former illegal landfill on Bishop Road as Bishop Industrial Park, groundbreaking October 30, 2025 at 7635 Bishop Road. Ask the city whether the park's site plan or land disturbance permit takes in 7500 Herndon Road.
No site plan, land disturbance permit or development-authority release naming 7500 Herndon Road was found. Ask the city and the Development Authority of Fulton County.
Ask Georgia EPD whether any landfill or dump permit or Hazardous Site Inventory listing covers 7500 Herndon Road itself; the brief flags none on this parcel.

open_items: The Georgia Secretary of State record (status, formation date, registered agent, principal office) was not read: known wall. The developer-or-investor reading rests on the entity form, the out-of-state mailing address, the purchase after the 2024 industrial cases and the assemblage; it is an inference, not a record.
Confirm whether the house is occupied or leased; a tenant would affect timing.
